pages.title: Voidstone
pages.text: Veins of black stone run through the Hollow's islands. Only a $(l)diamond pickaxe$() will break it.$(br2)It yields $(item)Void Shards$(). With $(l)Silk Touch$(), the ore itself can be carried out whole.
Cold to the touch, and slightly heavier than it should be. The raw stuff of Forbidden artifacts.
